subject: Renewal + Upsell: e-invoice transition and billing contact for Q4 capacity add
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@skyline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + Upsell: e-invoice transition and billing contact for Q4 capacity add

Hi Marta —

Congrats again on the renewed commitment — excited to have Skyline increase committed capacity by 35% for Q4. To keep billing smooth for the upsell, a couple quick asks from our side:

- Can you confirm the PO number (or confirm Procurement will submit a PO) that should cover the renewal + capacity add? We can accept a single PO that references deal SKy-2026-REN-09.
- We're switching eligible customers to e-invoicing (PEPPOL/Ariba) by default. Do you have a preferred e-invoice channel (Ariba network vendor ID or Coupa/Peppol address)? If yes, please send the vendor ID so we can route invoices automatically.
- We also need the updated AP contact for billing (name, email, phone) and the tax form you expect from us (W-9, VAT form, etc.). 

Attaching a PO template and our W-9 to speed things up. If Procurement prefers DocuSign, loop me in and I’ll route the quote.

Next steps: if you can send the PO or vendor ID today, Monica (cc'd) will confirm invoice timing and finalize the billing contact on our side.

Thanks —
Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0138

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template_SKY-2026-REN-09.pdf, Redwood_W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf
From: Marta Gomez <marta@skyline.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: finance+payables@skyline.ai, Procurement Team <procurement@skyline.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Upsell: e-invoice transition and billing contact for Q4 capacity add

Hi Rishi —

Thanks — great news on the capacity add, excited to extend. Procurement will issue a single PO that covers the full term + add; tentative PO number will be provided once the internal approval clears (should be today or tomorrow).

Regarding e-invoicing: we can accept Ariba e-invoices. Our Ariba vendor ID is 60012345. Please register Redwood with that ID so invoices route to our AP. If registration requires a vendor form, let me know and I’ll have Procurement complete it.

AP contact for billing:
- Name: Elena Sorensen
- Email: finance+payables@skyline.ai
- Phone: +1 312-555-0199

We require a current W-9 on file for US subsidiaries. The attached W-9 looks fine; Procurement may still ask for the certificate of incorporation for our records (I’ll confirm).

Marta
Head of Customer Success | Skyline AI
marta@skyline.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@skyline.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T13:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Upsell: e-invoice transition and billing contact for Q4 capacity add

Marta / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and the Ariba vendor ID. Two operational notes from Finance / Billing:

1) Vendor onboarding: Connor (cc) will submit the Redwood vendor registration into Ariba today using vendor ID 60012345. He may request the company registration PDF if the Ariba flow flags mismatch. Can Procurement expect a request?

2) PO handling & invoicing cadence: once we receive the PO number we will match invoices to it. For the upsell we will issue an initial invoice covering the prorated add (effective 2026-11-01) and then regular monthly invoices per the committed capacity cadence. If Skyline prefers a single consolidated invoice for the renewed term, confirm and we will follow that pattern.

Connor — please confirm you have access to the Ariba portal and will push the registration. Monica — Ill hand the final invoice schedule to you when PO is confirmed so Billing can set AR alerts.

Cheers,
Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: procurement@skyline.ai, Marta Gomez <marta@skyline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood vendor registration (Ariba ID 60012345)

Hi Procurement / Marta —

Looping in on vendor onboarding — I started the Ariba vendor registration for Redwood using vendor ID 60012345. You may receive a vendor validation email from Ariba that requests:
- Company legal name and address
- Tax ID / W-9 (attached)
- Preferred remit-to address and email (we will set finance+invoices@redwood.com)

If you could approve the vendor registration or tell us the preferred connector owner on your side, well ensure invoices are delivered electronically.

Quick note on invoice layout: to ensure automatic matching, please have the PO number included on the invoice and the description reference deal SKy-2026-REN-09.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Revenue Operations — Billing Integration Lead | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

Connor / team —

Vendor registration approved. PO # SKY-PO-78921 will be issued today and will reference deal SKY-2026-REN-09 and the prorated Q4 add. We confirmed Redwood as an Ariba supplier (60012345) — invoices should route to finance+payables@skyline.ai.

Procurement also attached a short supplier checklist (see Drive link) and asked that Redwood include the PO number on the invoice header and in the EDI/invoice metadata. Weve accepted the W-9 as well.

Please proceed with invoice issuance per the agreed cadence; we anticipate the first prorated invoice will be payable on receipt with our standard net30.

Thanks —
Skyline Procurement Team
procurement@skyline.ai
